storyline.real: Verstappen is fastest in qualifying but starts sixth after a grid penalty, passes his way to the front and wins by 22.3 s from Pérez.

eras.briefing: Spa, 2023. Verstappen was fastest in qualifying, but a five-place grid penalty puts him sixth. You run him, second and 2.8 s behind Pérez after ten laps. A brief shower comes on lap 20. Win it.
